meta.review_notes: Full analysis complete based on 25,271 character privacy policy. Key findings: AI model training opt-out available but on by default, extensive GDPR rights, data shared with service providers (Apple, RevenueCat, Dub), cookie data retained up to 25 months, data transferred outside EEA.

app.name: PhotoRoom: AI Photo Editor
app.description: An AI-powered photo editor that removes backgrounds, enhances images, and generates professional-quality visuals for e-commerce and social media.

verdict.one_liner: PhotoRoom edits your photos with AI and may use uploaded images to train models unless you opt out, but offers strong GDPR rights and doesn't sell data.
verdict.summary: PhotoRoom is a capable AI photo editor that processes your photos to remove backgrounds and enhance images. By default, your uploaded photos may be used to train AI models, though you can opt out at any time. The app collects device information and shares data with service providers including Apple and RevenueCat for refund validation, and Dub for referral programs. Cookie data may be retained for up to 25 months. On the positive side, PhotoRoom offers extensive GDPR rights, does not sell personal data under CCPA definitions, and provides clear opt-out options for AI training.
verdict.recommendation_reason: PhotoRoom's AI model training uses your uploaded photos by default. While you can opt out and the app offers strong privacy rights, consider whether you want your photos potentially used for training AI models. Avoid uploading sensitive personal photos.

red.title: Your uploaded photos may train AI models by default
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that by using the service, you acknowledge it processes and uses the images you upload to improve, train, and develop its products, services, and models. You can opt out at any time but this does not undo prior processing.

red.title: Cookie data kept for up to 25 months
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that social network and audience measurement cookies preserve your IP address and pages viewed for up to twenty-five months with your consent.

red.title: Data may be transferred outside Europe
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that your personal data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area, in particular because of the use of service providers located outside the EEA.

red.title: Long data retention periods
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom retains purchase records for 10 years, archived account data for 5 years after 2 years of inactivity, and cookie data for up to 25 months.

green.title: You can opt out of AI model training
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that you may opt out of having your uploaded photos used to train AI models at any time through your account settings.

green.title: Extensive GDPR rights available
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom provides comprehensive rights including access, rectification, erasure, data portability, restriction, objection, and post-mortem data choices, with responses within one month.

green.title: Does not sell or share data under CCPA meanings
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom explicitly states that it does not 'sell' or 'share' personal data as those terms are defined by the CCPA.

green.title: API uploads exempt from AI training
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom clarifies that its model improvement does not apply to images processed through its Application Programming Interface (API).

categories.policy_excerpt: Data sent by your phone's camera and photos stored on your phone. Contractual performance of the Terms between you and Photoroom. Access to the photos is only made with your permission. Duration of use of services or until withdrawal of your permission.

categories.detail: No explicit GPS collection mentioned. IP address collected via social network and audience measurement cookies (up to 25 months with consent), which may reveal approximate location. No location services mentioned for core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: Social network and audience measurement Cookies: Personal data collected (IP address, pages viewed, etc.) by the deposit of these Cookies. Consent. Up to 25 months.
concerns: IP address collected via cookies may reveal approximate location
Cookie data retained for up to 25 months

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook

You can opt-out of this at any time by changing the settings on your account. This opt out shall not have retroactive effect on processing activities already carried out.

Images selected and annotated without identity information for training

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom shares data with service providers including Apple and RevenueCat for refund validation, Dub for referral programs, and other technical providers. Data may be transferred outside the EEA with GDPR protections.
categories.detail: Third-party processors: technical/hosting, notifications, newsletters, user tracking, security. Apple and RevenueCat receive browsing/interaction data for refund validation (6 months). Dub receives email addresses for referral programs (with consent). Cookie providers receive data based on banner choices. Data transferred outside EEA with appropriate safeguards. Does not sell data under CCPA.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your Personal data may be transmitted to third-party processors involved in the provision of the Services... In particular, we transmit your browsing and interaction data on the Photoroom Application to Apple and RevenueCat... We use Dub as a service provider to operate and manage referral programs.
concerns: Multiple service providers receive user data
Browsing data shared with Apple and RevenueCat
Email addresses shared with Dub for referrals
Data transferred outside EEA

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom collects email address, full name, user ID, and optional profile photo. Account data retained until deletion or up to 2 years of inactivity, then archived for 5 years.
categories.detail: Account data: email (via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth, AppleAuth), full name, user ID, optional profile photo. Login credentials retained until deletion or 2 years dormancy, then archived 5 years. Purchase records retained 10 years for accounting. Transaction data retained for legal periods.
categories.policy_excerpt: Management of your account: Email address via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth or AppleAuth (optional), Full name, User ID. Duration of use of the services (=Until the account is deleted by you or up to a period of 2 years from your last connection to your account), and then archived for 5 years.
concerns: Purchase records retained for 10 years
Account data archived for 5 years after 2 years inactivity

App Store rating may be 4+ while service is 13+

Browsing data shared with third parties

categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom collects data relating to devices and equipment used to provide a functional application and improve services.
categories.detail: Device data collected under legitimate interest for providing functional Application and improving services. Retained for duration of use or 30 days after deletion request. No explicit mention of unique device identifiers for advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Proper operation of the Application and its Services: Data relating to your activity on Photoroom, Communications with Photoroom, Data relating to devices and equipment used. Legitimate interest in providing a functional Application/ improving our Application. Duration of use of the services, or 30 days after a request for deletion.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom does not collect health or biometric data for the core photo editing service.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection mentioned for core app functionality. CCPA section lists categories but does not indicate actual collection of such data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom does not process or keep credit card data itself - payment information is handled by third-party payment services providers. Purchase records are retained for 10 years.
categories.detail: Credit card and payment methods data not processed or kept by PhotoRoom - only by Payment Services Provider. Transaction data (purchase history, transaction amount, user's first and last name) retained for 10 years for accounting purposes. Email, full name, user ID used for payment processing.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please note that credit card or other payment methods data are not processed and kept by Photoroom but only by the Payment Services Provider. Purchase of subscription or paid features: Transaction data transmitted by the Store or by the Payment Services Provider (purchase history, transaction amount, user's first and last name). Length of time required to complete the transaction plus legal retention period for accounting purposes (10 years).
concerns: Purchase records retained for 10 years

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom provides extensive GDPR rights including access, rectification, erasure, data portability, restriction, objection, and post-mortem choices. Responses within one month, or up to three months for complex requests.
categories.detail: Comprehensive GDPR rights: access, rectification, erasure (right to be forgotten), restriction, portability, objection, post-mortem data choices, consent withdrawal. Response time: one calendar month, up to three months for complex requests. Some data retained for legal periods after deletion. AI training opt-out available but doesn't undo prior processing.
categories.policy_excerpt: People may exercise extensive controls including Right of access, Right to rectification, Right to erasure/right to be forgotten, Right to restriction of processing, Right to data portability, Right to object, Right to determine what happens to your personal data after your death, Right to withdraw your consent. Photoroom undertakes to respond to your requests... within one calendar month... If your request is complex... up to three calendar months.
concerns: Some data retained for legal limitation periods
Opt-out of AI training does not undo prior processing

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that the privacy policy may be amended and that it will set up a way to inform you of changes, but does not specify exact notification methods or advance notice periods.
categories.detail: Policy may be amended to reflect changes in practices or regulations. PhotoRoom will set up a way to inform users of changes. No specific notification mechanism (email, in-app, posting) stated. No explicit advance notice period mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Privacy Policy may be amended and updated to reflect changes in Photoroom's data protection practices, or to ensure compliance with regulations when they are amended. In this case, we will set up a way to inform you of this change.
concerns: Notification method not specified
No explicit advance notice period stated
